content.comment_body: I would like to use multiple screens on the [product_name] display. Can anyone share example programs or advice on how to approach this?
Could you clarify your needs? Do you want to show several message texts, or create a menu for navigating between messages? Also, have you tried the online help resource?
Here's an example of a ticker function.

Thanks for sharing the example. So, the ticker function is triggered only by a specific time, not by markers or variables, correct? I have read the help but found it confusing or insufficient. Ideally, I want more space for displaying messages, alarms, and variables, and it would be great to allow data entry too. So, I think I would need navigation to move through several message texts.

While forums can provide assistance, they don't replace structured courses. What can be done with reports depends on your goals. Message texts display only when activated, and amongst active messages, the one with the highest priority is shown. You can scroll between active messages using cursor keys. If you wish to assign different switching functions to the same key or input, you can control this with message texts. You would lock a key or input based on which message text is active, and create a menu allowing you to activate specific message texts. For example: Active message text 1 plus input I1 triggers function 1; active message text 2 plus input I1 triggers function 2; active message text 3 plus input I1 triggers function 3.
Are you looking to enable more subscreens on the [product_name]? For example, pointing with a cursor to show a new screen with additional data or variables?
This might be useful. I hadn't considered it; support mentioned it. I can't recall where I found it.
Hi [user_name], what is your exact issue?
Hello, I don't have an issue now. I thought this could help others. Sorry, I’m using a translator so my wording may not be perfect.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking methods to utilize multiple screens or message areas on the [product_name] display to improve data visibility and interaction. The main difficulty is in navigating and managing message texts, alarms, and variable displays, especially given the documentation gaps and limited built-in navigation features. There is some uncertainty about triggering menu navigation and organizing subscreens and display functions efficiently.
analysis.user_expectations: Users wish to display additional information simultaneously and to be able to navigate between various screens, including entering data and monitoring several variables easily on the [product_name] display.
gain_keywords: improved display for alarms and messages
